artworks_packed_positive.name: artworks_packed_positive
artworks_packed_positive.value: ("artworks"."packed_length_mm" IS NULL OR "artworks"."packed_length_mm" > 0) AND ("artworks"."packed_width_mm" IS NULL OR "artworks"."packed_width_mm" > 0) AND ("artworks"."packed_height_mm" IS NULL OR "artworks"."packed_height_mm" > 0) AND ("artworks"."packed_weight_g" IS NULL OR "artworks"."packed_weight_g" > 0)

artworks_prices_positive.name: artworks_prices_positive
artworks_prices_positive.value: ("artworks"."price_ils_minor" IS NULL OR "artworks"."price_ils_minor" > 0) AND ("artworks"."price_usd_minor" IS NULL OR "artworks"."price_usd_minor" > 0) AND ("artworks"."offer_auto_decline_below_ils_minor" IS NULL OR "artworks"."offer_auto_decline_below_ils_minor" > 0)

artworks_customs_values_positive.name: artworks_customs_values_positive
artworks_customs_values_positive.value: ("artworks"."declared_value_override_minor" IS NULL OR "artworks"."declared_value_override_minor" > 0) AND ("artworks"."max_insurable_value_minor" IS NULL OR "artworks"."max_insurable_value_minor" >= 0)

generated_documents_has_owner.name: generated_documents_has_owner
generated_documents_has_owner.value: "generated_documents"."order_id" IS NOT NULL OR "generated_documents"."sale_id" IS NOT NULL

orders_paid_has_attempt.name: orders_paid_has_attempt
orders_paid_has_attempt.value: "orders"."status" NOT IN ('PAID', 'COMPLETED') OR "orders"."paid_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL

refunds_one_live_per_cancellation_idx.name: refunds_one_live_per_cancellation_idx
refunds_one_live_per_cancellation_idx.where: "refunds"."cancellation_id" IS NOT NULL AND NOT ("refunds"."status" = 'FAILED' AND "refunds"."failure_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)

cancellations_identifier_present.name: cancellations_identifier_present
cancellations_identifier_present.value: "cancellations"."id_number_enc" IS NOT NULL OR "cancellations"."order_number_input" IS NOT NULL OR "cancellations"."order_id" IS NOT NULL

cancellations_amounts_nonnegative.name: cancellations_amounts_nonnegative
cancellations_amounts_nonnegative.value: ("cancellations"."fee_minor" IS NULL OR "cancellations"."fee_minor" >= 0) AND ("cancellations"."refund_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "cancellations"."refund_amount_minor" >= 0)

shipments_amounts_nonnegative.name: shipments_amounts_nonnegative
shipments_amounts_nonnegative.value: ("shipments"."declared_value_minor" IS NULL OR "shipments"."declared_value_minor" >= 0) AND ("shipments"."insured_value_minor" IS NULL OR "shipments"."insured_value_minor" >= 0) AND ("shipments"."insurance_premium_minor" IS NULL OR "shipments"."insurance_premium_minor" >= 0) AND ("shipments"."cost_actual_minor" IS NULL OR "shipments"."cost_actual_minor" >= 0) AND ("shipments"."charged_to_buyer_minor" IS NULL OR "shipments"."charged_to_buyer_minor" >= 0) AND "shipments"."label_attempt" >= 0
